request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:GUARD

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: rowdy, cheerful scrap-heap raiders, loud and silly, never grim. Bright sunny colours with clear light and dark: pale sand-buff leather straps and patched hide, colour #d0b073; light grey tin scrap with rivets, colour #9aa5a8; weathered grey-tan planks; bold hazard yellow paint, colour #fdd20f, daubed on plates, rims and anything that explodes; dark brown only for belts and boots.
layers.negative: gun, rifle, pistol, musket, cannon, modern car, rubber tyres, chrome, headlights, neon, glowing green, cyan glow, purple magic glow, skull, bones, blood, gore, horror, dark gloomy colours, black leather, dark brown leather, dark gunmetal armour, red cloth, orange leather, copper, brass, gold armour, grey skin

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute unit figure with a big head, short sturdy body and one oversized signature weapon or tool, thick single-colour black outline, standing ready pose, both feet visible; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple units, crowd

layers.text: Subject: Orc Brute, a chunky cute big broad orc with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a wide heavy body filling the whole width of the image: mid green skin, colour #4a8a3a, with lighter #6faa55 on the face, jaw, chest and belly and darker #326426 shading, a heavy jaw with two cream tusks, a flat nose, small grumpy eyes under a heavy brow, the whole face clearly visible, a small dented light grey tin cap on top of the head, a bare chest with a pale sand-buff leather harness and a sand-buff hide kilt, a big round light grey tin shield with a thick hazard yellow painted rim held on the left arm, a huge chunky light grey tin cleaver in the right hand, dark brown boots, wide braced stance; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a big shield bruiser.

layers.negative: helmet covering the face, visor, face guard, dark skin
